BEFORE WE LAUNCH

Get ready for takeoff.

Choose a collection mode and understand how your data is handled.

A research experience, not a diagnosis.

  • 01We record a pseudonymous ID, task performance, and three mental-fatigue ratings. Camera mode also records numerical eye and head features.
  • 02No video recording or photo storage. The model and camera frames are processed locally in your browser.
  • 03This independent preview saves only in this browser. It does not upload to the original research dashboard. The ID can link sessions within this browser.
  • 04You can stop or discard your session at any time, and export or delete local records. These tasks and eye metrics are not clinically validated.
